feed.title: NPR Topics: National
feed.subtitle: Follow NPR National News for reporting across the United States. Explore coverage of economic affordability, immigration, climate, environmental policy, justice and social trends.

entry.title: Hackers expose the identities of more than 40,000 DHS employees
entry.summary: A group of hacktivists calling themselves Distributed Denial of Secrets, said the unmasking of ICE agents, DHS operatives and contractors was fair play, given the government's lack of transparency.

entry.title: Forecasters are predicting a warmer and wetter winter. Here's how El Niño will affect your region.
entry.summary: El Niño years typically lead to more precipitation and higher-than-average temperatures. The latest data shows the different potential impacts by region.

entry.title: Trump administration wants to remove regulations on a super planet-heating gas
entry.summary: The Trump administration wants to undo a Biden-era rule that would reduce methane emissions from the oil and gas industry.

entry.title: New book revisits the 2023 killing of an unhoused man in crisis on the NYC subway
entry.summary: Jordan Neely was frightening fellow passengers. A former Marine named Daniel Penny put Neely into a chokehold, killing him. Journalist Anand Giridharadas investigates the incident in Man in the Mirror.

entry.title: Dolores Huerta, influential labor leader, feminist and civil rights icon, dies at 96
entry.summary: Huerta co-founded the United Farm Workers union to improve working conditions in the nation's fruit and vegetable fields and coined the phrase "Sí, se puede!" that became a widespread rallying cry.

entry.title: How a lifelong Republican came to lead the data center battle in Ohio
entry.summary: In Ohio, many people are displeased with the state's rapid buildout of data centers. It's a hot issue in the midterms, as political candidates from both parties try to ease voter concerns.

entry.title: Partnerships between ICE and local police surge, report finds
entry.summary: The number of state and local officers working with Immigration and Customs Enforcement has doubled in size in the last eight months, according to a new report from the immigration reform advocacy group FWD.us.

entry.title: Trump says he's ending restrictions on climate-warming methane from oil drilling
entry.summary: President Donald Trump said that his administration is "terminating" a Biden-era rule that aimed to cut planet-warming emissions of methane from oil and gas drilling.

entry.title: Southwest flood damage estimates are hundreds of millions for New Mexico alone
entry.summary: Intense rainstorms linked to a very active El Niño-driven Pacific hurricane season have left thousands of people in the Four Corners states displaced.

entry.title: A judge halted D.C. golf course renovations. Trump says they'll still start next month
entry.summary: A federal judge has barred the government from clearing more trees or making other alterations to D.C.'s East Potomac Park without proper notice. Trump says his administration will appeal.
